content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the intentional disabling of bypass mode for the SMMU (System Memory Management Unit) in the ARM architecture, which was implemented in a previous commit. This change affected devices on the Tegra186 platform that relied on bypass mode for proper operation, including the ethernet, BPMP (Boot and Power Management Processor), and HDA (High Definition Audio) devices. The devices were not properly configured with their respective stream IDs in the device tree, leading to their malfunction. The patch resolves this by adding the necessary iommus property with the correct stream IDs for these devices, allowing them to function securely with the SMMU.
